newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks climb at start on heavy buying.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks climb at start on heavy buying.

text.p: Dhaka stocks opened higher amid heavy buying pressure on the engineering counter, brokers said.
"All the scrips traded in the opening hour have gained. Buyers are asking for more but there are not sufficient scrips," said one broker.
Afatb Automobiles gained 99 taka to 987, BD Lamps rose 1,084 to 7,000 and Singer Bangladesh was up 1,000 to 14,700.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share index closed 5.69 percent or 109.17 up at 2025.17 on Wednesday.
